name: O-4210
summary: O-4210 is a drug developed by Organix Inc which acts as a selective dopamine reuptake inhibitor, with good selectivity over the serotonin transporter but its activity at the noradrenaline transporter is not known.

fact.en: It came out of a long search for drugs that block the dopamine transporter slowly and steadily, in the hope of treating cocaine addiction without producing a cocaine-like rush.
fact.zh: 它源自一項長期研究，目標是找出緩慢而穩定阻斷多巴胺轉運體的藥物，希望能治療古柯鹼成癮而不產生類似古柯鹼的快感。
fact.zhHans: 它源自一项长期研究，目标是找出缓慢而稳定阻断多巴胺转运体的药物，希望能治疗古柯碱成瘾而不产生类似古柯碱的快感。
